question: Should OpenClaw move from one active memory plugin slot to public purpose-specific memory role slots with per-agent overrides?
rationale: This changes public config shape and plugin runtime ownership, and VISION.md gives mixed signals between plugin API extensibility and the current one-active-memory-slot direction.

options.title: Sponsor role-slot architecture review
options.body: Continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation, requiring compatibility proof and doctor migration coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep one active memory slot
options.body: Reject role slots for now, document the one-slot policy clearly, and route memory composition to narrower prompt-supplement or plugin-specific hooks.

options.title: Narrow to coexistence repairs
options.body: Do not add role slots yet; instead solve only the highest-impact coexistence cases such as dreaming and prompt supplements with smaller compatibility-preserving changes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor role-slot architecture review
recommendation.body: Continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation, requiring compatibility proof and doctor migration coverage before merge.
